description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus total reactive energy is nonnegative.
explanation: NSM is a nonnegative daily-clock quantity and both reactive-energy components are nonnegative.

description: The daily-clock upper bound is not exceeded after accounting for nonnegative reactive-energy magnitudes.
explanation: NSM is defined to be below 86399 seconds, and adding nonnegative reactive-energy magnitudes preserves that upper-bound inequality in this canonical form.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus lagging power-factor percentage does not exceed 86499.
explanation: NSM is at most 86399 by definition and the lagging power factor is at most 100, so their sum is bounded by the sum of these independently defined maxima.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus leading power-factor percentage does not exceed 86499.
explanation: The daily clock is bounded by 86399 seconds and the leading power factor is bounded by 100 percentage points, giving this definition-based combined upper bound.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus both power-factor percentages does not exceed 86599.
explanation: Adding the defined maxima NSM less than 86400 and each power factor no greater than 100 yields a universal upper bound of 86599 for this combined quantity.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus estimated emissions is nonnegative.
explanation: Both elapsed time from midnight and estimated interval emissions are nonnegative by their definitions.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus active usage is nonnegative.
explanation: Both elapsed time on the daily clock and active interval electricity consumption are nonnegative quantities.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus lagging reactive energy is nonnegative.
explanation: NSM is a nonnegative daily-clock value and lagging reactive energy is a nonnegative magnitude.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus leading reactive energy is nonnegative.
explanation: Both the elapsed daily-clock value and leading reactive-energy magnitude are nonnegative.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus the lagging power-factor percentage is nonnegative.
explanation: NSM and the lagging power-factor percentage are both defined on nonnegative scales.

description: Elapsed seconds since midnight plus the leading power-factor percentage is nonnegative.
explanation: The daily-clock value and leading power-factor percentage cannot be negative under their stated definitions.
